mathematical_dependency_closure.constitutive_reference_fixture: grad, hessian, weights, kr, lam, mu; element-local artificial connectivity arange(4*ne), F0 zero, fixed_dofs empty; lift, fluctuation and direction gathered through real edofs; raw fixture additionally archives real connectivity/fixed/state/direction.
mathematical_dependency_closure.assembly_and_constraints: edofs, connectivity, fixed_dofs, free_dofs; all 3 local and global forces, all 3 saved element tangent tensors, full saved unsymmetrized CSC coefficients.
mathematical_dependency_closure.equilibrium_and_KKT: b_in, b_out, k_out, force_scale_per_length; row R_input, d and target_origin; q_in/q_out/constraint and force-scale/report diagnostics; fixed compatible v=b_in/max(abs(b_in)), fixed entries zero; deltaR=0.
mathematical_dependency_closure.signed_workpiece_projections: workpiece_dofs plus disjoint metadata support/entity_symmetry/background_symmetry groups, workpiece_background_symmetry_overlap_dofs; force on body is negative summed weak-form internal force. Lower Fy, upper [Fx,-Fy], full net [2Fx,0], two-sided normal magnitude sum 2abs(Fy); preserve original total/material/regularization scale rule.
mathematical_dependency_closure.fixed_body_field_sanity: workpiece_cells/dofs, dummy body F=I/J=1/Hu=0, undeformed split state and zero saved interior force/stress-first-Piola; these sanity fields do not constitute HP stress qualification.
mathematical_dependency_closure.source_provenance: Original source-freeze and old reference contract/summary bind production and reference methods. Current wrapper adds changed CLI/API orchestration; exact saved physical artifacts can share existing mathematical evidence, but orchestration timing/counts/terminal process evidence cannot be inherited.

qualification_reuse_conditions: Root must prove all model/state/force/tangent/CSC archive bytes and associated field metadata are identical over the exact 24 ordered states, including row multiplier, targets and constraints.
Root must bind old direction/reference fixture/artifact hashes to old successful summary and preserved source methods/physics, not rely on shared state IDs alone.
Use a new separate evidence-identity/citation record. Preserve original old reference and new result/response bytes, status flags, call counts and no-new-HP truth.
If complete mathematical closure passes, another 48 identical HP evaluations add no numerical coverage and can be omitted; new states/models/materials/directions are outside the reuse decision.
qualifications_legitimately_unchanged: All original force/equilibrium/constraint and signed workpiece projection gates for these exact saved states.
Single-direction total/material/regularization HP tangent action, saved CSC action and deltaR=0 KKT action.
All saved CSC coefficients independently checked against assembly of all element tensors; this is assembly coverage, not all-column HP derivative coverage.
qualifications_not_granted: Pressure, certified contact/clamping, stress-HP, candidate energy, all tangent columns, rejected trial states, H2/H3/HF5 or final labels/ranking.
New CLI/API runtime provenance, new model/states, new directions and future fine meshes cannot borrow prior execution.
